newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 2.84 pct up on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 2.84 pct up on foreign buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Tuesday amid sustained buying by foreign investors and speculators, dealers said.
"The index may consolidate with a strong upward momentum but only after successfully breaching the next resistance level of 2,000 points," a dealer at BMA Capital Management said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 54.25 points, or 2.84 percent, to close at 1,966.70 at 0903 GMT. Gainers beat losers 129 to 99.
Hub Power rose 2.80 rupees to 55.55 rupees and Karachi Electric 3.50 to 26.25. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
